prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished character-centered WIND splash illustration of the exact C3 brown-haired teal archer in images 1 and 2. Single finished scene, near-square canvas, genuinely transparent outside the isolated splash silhouette.
INPUT ROLES: 1=C3 front and 2=C3 three-quarter, authoritative SAME CHARACTER design and rendering references. 3=C4 FACE LINE QUALITY only: clean eyelids, small nose/mouth, restrained skin; do not copy silver hair, ponytail or her armor. 4=background spatial treatment ONLY: clean anime color planes, dynamic wrapping effects with real perspective and depth. Do not copy its woman, costume, water, dice or diamond frame.
IDENTITY LOCK: C3 is an adult female elf archer, long flowing chestnut brown hair, teal eyes, pointed ears, elegant slender tall adult proportions. Keep her recognizable face, parted fringe, long loose hair, blue/turquoise feather ornament with golden base on her anatomical left temple. Preserve teal high-neck long-sleeved outfit with white chest insert, wing-shaped GOLD shoulder and chest plates, dark waist belt, layered split teal coat panels and long teal tails with gold edging, charcoal thigh-high boots with teal upper plates and gold knee/toe armor, gold forearm guards, blue gem accents. Retain one ornate dark-and-gold recurved longbow with angular leaf/wing-like limbs and blue tassel. These original gold fittings and brown hair remain; requested WHITE / GRAY / PALE LIME GREEN / TEAL palette governs the environment and wind, not a redesign of the character.
ACTION: dynamic graceful three-quarter full-body aerial archery pose, leaping from a small broken white-stone sky bridge. Torso twists toward the shot, right hand holds bow forward toward image left and slightly upward, left hand draws a SINGLE nocked wind arrow and string back to her cheek, elbow behind her. Coherent functional bow mechanics: a continuous bowstring connects both limb tips through the drawn nock, arrow shaft passes across the bow grip and points away from the archer, natural fingers and wrists. Focused confident expression looking along the arrow. One knee lifted, other leg stretched back/down, neither foot cropped. Hair and split teal coat tails swept toward image right by the same gale. Attractive heroic athletic action, not pinup. Preserve costume coverage.
BACKGROUND CONCEPT: wind sculpting a white and cool-gray ruined sky bridge. A few elegant broken pale stone arch segments farther behind, angled and foreshortened, with open sky-like negative space between them, no large solid landscape rectangle. The stone is a subordinate visual stage, not a huge pedestal dominating the picture. Two sweeping pale-white and translucent teal air currents travel from behind the arches around the body and into the foreground before converging toward the arrow's direction. The breeze is visible as thin tapering aerodynamic sheets, wispy pressure streaks, narrow pale lime accents and a FEW small leaves carried along the flow. Depict airy WIND, not water, waves, ice, liquid droplets or opaque green tentacles. Some current sections pass behind the archer, some in front below her knees, never over her face or drawing hands. Vary width and foreshortening so it occupies actual space rather than becoming a flat ornamental ring.
COMPOSITION: open asymmetric S-curve, low-left to upper-right counterflow, clear foreground/midground/background. Character is large and readable, full-body height around 65-70 percent of canvas; face and bow action are focal. Foreground one or two larger gray-white stone fragments and a pale-green leaf, middle archer, rear softened pale arch fragments. Light negative space behind face, dark teal costume separated from pale currents. Avoid excessive tiny particles, extra beasts, wings, giant portraits, extra humans, text or generic magic circles.
STYLE: match C3's fine crisp hand-drawn 2D anime linework and disciplined cel shading, C4-quality facial construction. Large coherent tapered hair locks, broad matte cloth shadow planes, gold metal with clear facets, edge thickness, dark overlaps and narrow controlled highlights. Effects and background share clean anime rendering with selective soft translucency; dimensional composition, NOT photorealism or a 3D render. No fuzzy painterly texture, plastic skin, all-over glow, uniform detail noise or flat graphic pattern backdrop.
LIGHT: soft white daylight from upper left and restrained teal/lime reflected light from the air currents; consistent on skin, cloth, metal and stone. Overall fresh white, pearl gray, pale spring green and teal environment; original brown and gold restricted to the C3 design.
SAFETY: include entire hair, both feet, full bow limb tips, arrow tip, coat tails and all major effects with at least 7 percent clear margin. No clipping. No labels, C3 lettering, UI, watermark, border or multiple views. Transparent alpha outside the complete composed splash, no black rectangular background or drawn checkerboard.
framingEdit: Edit this exact C3 wind splash illustration ONLY to correct framing. Preserve the same character identity, face, long brown hair, pointed ears, teal-and-gold costume, feather hair ornament, pose, bow, single arrow, wind currents, white ruined arches, green leaves, original clean anime drawing style and colors. Zoom the ENTIRE existing composition out about 18 percent on the same square canvas. Fully reconstruct and reveal the clipped upper golden bow limb tip, any lower stone edges and wind endpoints, and any rightmost hair/cloth tips. Every major silhouette must be completely contained with clear transparent safety margin on ALL FOUR SIDES, at least 7 percent of canvas width/height. Do not merely add empty border around already clipped forms: finish the upper bow tip naturally. Preserve all existing spatial relationships, face details, costume design, lighting, hands and action. Do not add new objects or change the scene. Keep genuine alpha transparency and clean translucent wind. One single finished splash, no text, watermark, panels, solid background or checkerboard.
